ELY, Nev. – The Bureau of Land Management began a wild horse gather Nov. 14, in and around the Antelope Complex Herd Management Area in northern Nevada, to protect the health of the herd as late season forage declines and winter approaches. The gather will help reduce the risks wild horses face when the range can no longer support the current population. The Antelope Complex includes the Antelope, Antelope Valley, Goshute, and Spruce-Pequop Herd Management Areas. Horses may appear healthy at the start of the fall, but forage and water resources are limited. With far more wild horses on the landscape than the range can sustain, competition intensifies, creating conditions that can lead to malnutrition, dehydration, and long-distance travel in search of food and water

These prescribed burns aim to reduce hazardous fuel accumulations, enhance forest health and landscape resiliency, protect wildlife habitats, and improve firefighter and public safety by reducing wildfire risks. (Photo courtesy of TJ Lopez, volunteer) As the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) commemorates 80 years of public‑land stewardship , we continue to highlight the everyday efforts that strengthen our connection to communities and the landscapes we protect. One recent example comes from Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area , where a local student film has brought new attention to the work of BLM rangers and to the spirit of partnership that defines public land management. BLM Nevada Park Ranger Chad Hoing played a central role in a College of Southern Nevada (CSN) student film created by filmmaker Carl Petersen — an impactful piece that was officially selected for a CSN showcase and won an award for its outstanding quality and storytelling. BLM promotes agave restoration to support bat conservation within Las Cienegas National Conservation Area Apr 8, 2022 The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Tucson Field Office is collaborating with Bat Conservation International (BCI) and the Borderland Restoration Network (BRN) in Patagonia, Arizona, to promote agave restoration through planting nursery grown native agave plants on the Las Cienegas National Conservation Area (NCA). The primary goal is to encourage the growth of new agave stands to facilitate and sustain the migration pathways of nectar-feeding bats. When wildfire conditions make direct suppression difficult or unsafe, firefighters look for places where they can use the landscape to slow a fire's spread. Reducing vegetation along roads can create a break in fuels, giving firefighters another option if conditions change. That approach was used along nearly 2 miles of Cimarron Road northeast of Ridgway. Crews removed vegetation within approximately 75 feet of the roadside to create a potential firebreak if the fire moved in that direction. Before the work began, Ken Smothers, forester with the BLM's Gunnison Field Office, completed an expedited timber cruise to identify trees that could be recovered and sold rather than left as waste. It is the underlying technology for many cryptocurrency systems, but it can also be used in other types of applications. A blockchain is the ledger itself. It contains transactional records that are grouped into blocks. Each block is cryptographically linked to the previous block, making the ledger tamper evident. If data in an earlier block is changed, the cryptographic link to that block changes, and the change can be detected in later blocks. As new blocks are added, older blocks become more difficult to modify, creating tamper resistance. A blockchain network is the network in which a blockchain is used. Copies of the ledger are maintained across nodes in the network, and new blocks are added according to established validation and consensus rules. This distributed structure, together with cryptographic mechanisms, helps make the blockchain resilient to later attempts to alter the ledger. pages.text: Bobby Thomson's Scottish family reacts on his home run's 75th anniversary Skip to Content Design by Tom Forget It was called “The shot heard ‘round the world” – though the newspaper editors who coined it likely had no idea how right they were. While American baseball has never been shy about applying a global moniker to its domestic contests (it is called the World Series after all), Bobby Thomson’s iconic pennant-winning home run against the Brooklyn Dodgers on Oct. 3, 1951 really did deserve the globe-spanning moniker. These games were among the first to receive nationwide broadcast on television and radio, with the call also going out to U.S. service members around the world thanks to Armed Forces Radio. And then there was Thomson, who was originally born in a two-room tenement building in Glasgow, becoming known in the States as “The Staten Island Scot.” But what was the reaction back in Thomson’s homeland of Scotland? ​ “Every once in a while, you do come across somebody who's aware of Bobby Thomson, but I wouldn't say it's in everyday Scottish sports folklore,” John Tafe, an American ex-pat and the current president of Baseball Scotland, told MLB.com. “He's not on the pantheon of Scottish heroes or anything like that. pages.text: Bomba and bioluminescence—Puerto Rico is full of surprises | National Geographic By Amanda Canning Last updated December 17, 2025 This article was produced by National Geographic Traveller (UK). The inhabitants of San Juan aren’t early risers. At 9am, the city’s streets are largely empty. In the Plaza Colón, there’s a cockerel scrabbling about in the flower beds. A kiosk selling coffee and empanadas is untroubled by customers. “We like a slow start,” Laura Ortiz-Villamil confirms as we sit in the shade, the sun already blazing. In front of us is a statue of Christopher Columbus, a crucifix raised in his left hand. Among the first Europeans to barrel over the Atlantic, all eager to get their hands on whatever land they could, he ‘discovered’ Puerto Rico in 1493 and immediately claimed it for Spain. “The Spanish called it Puerto Rico — rich port — wrongly believing there was gold here,” Laura says as we set off on a stroll around the capital’s historic district, Old San Juan. A born-and-bred Puerto Rican, with tattoos on her arms ranging from Gabriel García Márquez quotes to Peanuts characters, historian Laura set up her guiding company in 2022 to share her country’s “less-known stories, good or bad”. We wander cobbled streets flanked by houses with arched wooden doorways and overhanging balconies, painted in every colour you might think of: pistachio, peach, lemon, spearmint. Located 120 miles west of Salt Lake City in Tooele County, Utah, the salt flats are a 30,000 acre expanse of hard, white salt crust on the western edge of the Great Salt Lake Basin in Utah. Like the Great Salt Lake, the Salt Flats are a remnant of Lake Bonneville, which covered over one-third of Utah from 10,000 to 32,000 years ago. Close booktiger's Diary [转载]可不能“随手一标”！ Posted by booktiger on 17 October 2026 in Chinese (China) (‪中文(中国大陆)‬) . 可不能“随手一标”！ 来源：国家安全部 2026年10月17日07:03 北京 https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Xri2QFc-6VPpZ6QLBaqjgw 一张看似普通的网络地图，一个出于“兴趣”的随手标注，竟可能危害国家秘密安全。近年来，随着地理信息技术的普及，“开放地图”平台逐渐走入公众视野，但其背后隐藏的国家安全风险却不容忽视。 一个“爱好”带来的麻烦 2021年，许某在社交媒体上被一张带有艺术风格的路网地图所吸引。出于好奇，他开始接触境外开放地图平台，并违法“翻墙”访问。许某凭借对居住地周边环境的了解，以及从互联网搜集的公开信息，开始在境外开放地图平台上标注各类地理信息，多次标注军队等涉密敏感单位的位置信息。国家安全机关发现许某违法行为后迅速采取行动，依法对其开展审查。面对审查，许某懊悔道：“我完全没想到，自己只是出于爱好做点标记，竟会触犯法律，威胁国家安全。”国家安全机关向其宣讲了相关法律法规，讲明了其行为的危害性，并依法对其进行处理。许某表示已深刻认识到错误，并积极配合消除隐患。 随手一标，隐患巨大 “开放地图”一般指数据开源、可自由使用与编辑的地图项目，经常由全球志愿者共同创建、编辑并免费共享地理数据，在碳中和、城乡交通建设、灾害风险评估研究等方面具备相应应用价值。但如果在开放地图平台上标注我国涉密敏感地理信息，就有可能被不法分子利用，对我国家安全造成危害。不法分子无需动用复杂的技术手段，仅凭开放地图便能轻易获取我国涉密敏感单位的位置、规模等信息，并据此在军事基地等涉密敏感单位附近开展“黑飞”、偷拍、测绘等活动。境外间谍情报机关还可能结合其他渠道获取的信息进行多源数据交叉比对，拼凑成完整情报，甚至还可能对涉密单位工作人员以及周边居民、商户等人员开展针对性的渗透、拉拢和策反活动，对我国家安全构成严重威胁。 国家安全机关提示 《 中华人民共和国保守国家秘密法 》《 中华人民共和国测绘法 》《 公开地图内容表示规范 》等法律法规划出清晰底线：个人或者组织非法获取、持有、提供、利用属于国家秘密的地理信息的，将被依法追责。开放地图不是个人兴趣的“涂鸦板”，看似无心的标注可能触碰国家秘密“红线”。 ——绷紧“安全弦”。增强国家安全意识，不在地图平台标注任何涉及军事基地、涉密单位的地理信息。 ——把好“出口关”。不在社交平台发布涉密场所周边照片、视频，拍照前留意背景是否涉及敏感场所，不转发、不扩散任何标注有涉密地理信息的地图内容。 ——当好“守护者”。如发现在公开地图标注涉密地理信息等危害国家安全的可疑情况，请及时通过12339国家安全机关举报受理电话、网络举报受理平台（ www.12339.gov.cn ）、国家安全部微信公众号举报受理渠道或者直接向当地国家安全机关进行举报。 Discussion Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment
